name: ToDo - ロック画面ウィジェット
subtitle: 優先順位とウィジェットでタスク管理
description:
やることを、緊急度と重要度で整理するTodoアプリです。

■ 4つの優先順位で整理
「緊急かつ重要」「重要だが緊急ではない」「緊急だが重要ではない」「緊急でも重要でもない」の4分類で、タスクを見渡せます。期限日時やメモも設定できます。

■ ウィジェットからタスクを完了
ホーム画面の小・中・大のウィジェットで、優先タスクと期限を確認。iOS 17以降ではタスクをタップすると、その場で完了できます。

■ ロック画面で今日と次を確認
今日が期限の未完了件数と、次のタスクを表示します。表示する情報はアプリの設定で切り替えられます。iOS 17以降では対応レイアウトの次のタスクをタップして完了できます。

■ 好きな日時と曜日にリマインダー
1つのタスクに複数の通知日時を指定できます。期限の10分前・30分前・1時間前の通知も追加できます。「毎日8時」や「月・水・金の19時」など、好きな曜日・時刻で繰り返す通知にも対応。タスクを完了すると通知は止まります。通知の表示や音はiPhoneの通知設定・集中モードに従います。

■ 自分に合う配色
オフホワイト、ダーク、端末に合わせる配色に加え、グリーン・ブルー・ラベンダー・ローズ・オレンジ・グレーの6色からアプリのテーマカラーを選べます。

タスクと設定は端末内に保存します。アカウント登録は不要です。

reviewNotes:
Review information for version 1.1.0, build 7

1. Update and testing
This update adds multiple custom local reminder dates, daily/selected-weekday repeating reminders, widget task completion on iOS 17+, and six in-app theme colors. The app supports iOS 16.4+; interactive widget buttons require iOS 17+. There is no login, paid content, or server setup. The earlier physical-device recording, todo-physical-app-flow.mov, was captured with version 1.0.0 (build 6) and demonstrates the previous core app flow; it does not demonstrate these new features.

2. Purpose and audience
Todo is a personal productivity app for Japanese-speaking general consumers. It organizes private tasks by urgency and importance, offers local reminders, and displays pending tasks in Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.

3. Setup and main features
- Launch Todo, tap "＋ タスクを追加", enter a title and choose urgency/importance. A deadline and memo are optional. Tap "タスクを保存".
- Tap a task title to edit it, or its circle to complete it. "完了済み" opens completed tasks, which can be restored.
- In the editor, "＋ 通知日時を追加" adds independent one-off reminder dates. A deadline is not required. When a deadline is set, the 10/30/60-minute presets add reminders without replacing existing dates.
- Enable "繰り返し通知" for a daily reminder (default 08:00). Set a time, choose "毎日" or "平日", or tap individual weekday buttons. At least one weekday stays selected. These notifications repeat while the task is incomplete, using device local time. They do not automatically recreate or reset completed tasks.
- Allow notifications when saving a task with reminders. Completing/deleting a task or turning off its reminders cancels the corresponding requests. iOS notification settings and Focus apply. Notifications can be received while the app is closed. The combined limit is 60 pending notification requests; selected weekdays use one request per day, daily uses one.
- Add a Home Screen widget by searching for Todo in iOS Add Widget; small, medium and large sizes are supported. On iOS 17+, tapping a task row completes it without opening the editor. The app merges the completion when it next runs. Tapping the widget background opens the task list.
- Add "Todo / 今日と次のタスク" through iOS Lock Screen customization. Inline, circular and rectangular layouts are supported. The rectangular next-task button and the circular next-task-only configuration can complete the next task on iOS 17+. Inline text is not interactive. "Today" counts incomplete tasks due on the local calendar date. "Next" chooses the nearest deadline, or priority order when no deadlines exist.
- In "設定", select light/dark/system appearance, one of six "テーマカラー" choices, and the two Lock Screen display preferences. Theme colors apply to app controls; widget colors follow the existing light/dark setting.
- All tasks, drafts and settings persist locally. No sample file or account credentials are needed.

4. External services/tools
Core features use React Native/Expo, AsyncStorage, Apple WidgetKit/SwiftUI and App Intents with an App Group, and iOS local notifications. There is no backend, cloud sync, remote push service, authentication, advertising, analytics, payment processor, AI service, or external task-data provider. Support/privacy links open dopa-min.jp in the external browser and are not required for core features.

5. Regions
Distribution remains Japan-only. There are no region-based feature differences. The interface is Japanese and dates/notifications use device local time.

6. Accounts, content, payments and regulated services
There are no accounts, social sharing, public user-generated content, paid features, subscriptions, in-app purchases, regulated services or protected third-party materials. Task text remains private on the device.
